FN-SL9ZX78-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 183
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Susan DuBose
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 183 as introduced would increase the obligations of the local boards of education,
beginning with the 2027-2028 school year, by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of
any required increase in instructional personnel and/or classroom space to accommodate
home-schooled students participating in career and technical programs in public schools, as
provided by this bill. These obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of
course fees received from the student equal to the fee charged to an enrolled public school
student, as provided by this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education and the local school boards of education to adopt rules and policies, respectively,
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
